pages.title: Openness: how curiosity and familiarity can shape choices
pages.summary: Read openness as a continuous tendency toward ideas, imagination, aesthetics, feelings, varied actions, and reconsidered values—not as a measure of intelligence or creativity.
pages.definition: Openness describes how readily someone engages with unfamiliar ideas, experiences, perspectives, and inner impressions. It is a broad observation lens: a score cannot show whether a new idea is good, whether a familiar routine is bad, or how capable a person is.

range.high: A higher result may fit frequent exploration, comfort revising assumptions, or attention to imaginative and aesthetic experience. It can also bring distraction when every alternative stays open.
range.middle: A middle result may fit selective curiosity: novelty is welcome when it serves a purpose, while reliable routines remain useful elsewhere. The mix can change by subject and risk.
range.low: A lower result may fit preference for tested methods, concrete information, and familiar environments. This can support consistency while making some ambiguous or rapidly changing situations less appealing.

facets.label: Imagination
facets.focus: mental simulation, fantasy, and invented possibilities

facets.label: Aesthetics
facets.focus: attention and response to art, design, and sensory form

facets.label: Feelings
facets.focus: awareness of and interest in emotional experience

facets.label: Actions
facets.focus: willingness to vary routines and try unfamiliar activities

facets.label: Ideas
facets.focus: engagement with concepts, arguments, and intellectual exploration

facets.label: Values
facets.focus: readiness to examine conventions and reconsider assumptions

pages.scenario: A data analyst uses the same trusted dashboard for monthly reporting but proposes interviews when a new customer group behaves unexpectedly. The first choice protects comparability; the second opens a new source of evidence. Both behaviors can coexist, so the useful question is what triggered exploration rather than whether the person is simply ‘open’.
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: Exploration can surface alternatives and connect distant ideas, while preference for familiarity can preserve focus and accumulated practice. Too much novelty can fragment execution; too little can hide changing conditions. Neither pole is a general advantage without a task and constraint.
pages.combination_effects: Openness paired with higher conscientiousness may turn a novel idea into a tested plan; paired with lower conscientiousness it may generate many starts with fewer completions. This is a hypothesis about interaction, not a formula or prediction.
pages.action_experiment: For one week, mark three moments when you chose a familiar method and three when you explored an alternative. Record the uncertainty, cost of switching, and outcome. Review whether your choices followed habit, evidence, or the actual stakes.
pages.misconceptions: Openness is not intelligence, artistic talent, education, political identity, or moral sophistication. A lower result does not mean closed-mindedness, and a higher result does not prove originality. One overall score may also hide different facet patterns.
pages.method_boundary: Research supports broad Big Five domains and more specific hierarchical descriptions, but named facet systems differ. These examples are editorial observation prompts pending human review; they do not independently validate a FermatMind score, diagnose anyone, or determine learning, hiring, or life outcomes.

visible_sources.limitation: Supports a broad factor structure, not FermatMind score validity or a universal facet taxonomy.
Describes one five-domain, 15-facet model; it does not make alternative facet systems interchangeable.

pages.title: 开放性：在新可能与熟悉经验之间怎样选择
pages.summary: 从想象、审美、感受、行动、观念与价值六个侧面观察对新经验的接近方式，不把开放性等同于聪明、创意或见识。
pages.definition: 开放性关注一个人如何接近陌生观念、体验、角度和内在感受。它描述的是倾向，不负责判断某个新方案是否正确，也不能说明一个人的知识、创造力或能力高低。

range.high: 较高结果可能对应更常主动探索、愿意修改原有看法，或更留意想象与审美体验；代价可能是选项不断增加，难以及时收束。
range.middle: 中间结果可能表现为有条件地尝试：在熟悉领域保留稳定做法，面对真正的新问题再扩大探索。不同主题上的选择未必一致。
range.low: 较低结果可能对应偏好具体信息、经过检验的方法和可预期环境；这有助于积累与稳定，也可能让高度模糊的变化更消耗精力。

facets.label: 想象
facets.focus: 构造画面、设想可能与进入虚构世界

facets.label: 审美
facets.focus: 对艺术、设计和感官形式的留意与反应

facets.label: 感受
facets.focus: 觉察、区分并探索自身情绪经验的方式

facets.label: 行动
facets.focus: 改变日常做法和尝试陌生活动的意愿

facets.label: 观念
facets.focus: 对概念、论证和知识探索的投入

facets.label: 价值
facets.focus: 检视惯例并重新评估既有假设的意愿

pages.scenario: 策展志愿者第一次布置社区展览时，坚持沿用往年的动线；发现儿童总在入口拥堵后，她邀请家长共同画出新路线并做半天试验。保留旧方案降低准备成本，小范围试验回应新证据。两种选择放在一起，比一句“她喜欢创新”更有解释力。
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: 探索能够发现替代方案，熟悉经验能够减少不必要的重学。持续追新可能让注意力分散，过度依赖旧做法也可能错过环境变化。更重要的是判断什么时候值得打开选项、什么时候应该停止搜索。
pages.combination_effects: 开放性较高且尽责性也较高时，新设想可能更容易变成可检验步骤；开放性较高而尽责性较低时，点子可能丰富但收尾较少。这只是待观察的组合假设，不是计算公式。
pages.action_experiment: 连续七天记录六次选择：三次沿用熟悉方案，三次尝试新方法。写下不确定性、切换成本和实际结果，再判断你是在依据证据选择，还是只是在重复习惯。
pages.misconceptions: 开放性不等于智力、艺术天赋、受教育程度或某种价值立场。较低并非思想封闭，较高也不保证原创。总体分数相近的人，六个侧面的组合仍可能不同。
pages.method_boundary: 研究支持大五的宽泛维度与层级描述，但不同模型使用的侧面体系并不相同。这里的场景化文字是等待人工复审的观察提示，不独立验证费马测试分数，也不用于诊断、录用或预测人生结果。

visible_sources.limitation: 支持宽泛因子结构，不验证费马测试分数，也不定义通用侧面体系。

visible_sources.citation_label: Soto 与 John（2017）：BFI-2 层级模型
visible_sources.limitation: 描述五维度、15 侧面的特定模型，不能与其他侧面体系默认互换。

pages.title: Conscientiousness: structure, follow-through, and adaptive effort
pages.summary: Explore how planning and persistence can help or hinder depending on risk, timing, and flexibility across six narrower facets.
pages.definition: Conscientiousness describes tendencies around organization, reliability, goal pursuit, self-regulation, and deliberation. It does not measure moral worth, obedience, productivity under every condition, or whether a particular plan deserves to be completed.

range.high: A higher result may fit advance planning, steady follow-through, and attention to obligations. It can become costly when standards stay rigid after priorities change.
range.middle: A middle result may fit selective structure: detailed systems for consequential work and lighter coordination for tasks that are easy to reverse.
range.low: A lower result may fit spontaneity, rapid response, or comfort leaving options open. It can also increase missed handoffs when commitments require sustained tracking.

facets.label: Competence
facets.focus: felt capability and practical effectiveness

facets.label: Order
facets.focus: preference for arrangement, systems, and predictable placement

facets.label: Dutifulness
facets.focus: attention to commitments, rules, and obligations

facets.label: Achievement striving
facets.focus: investment in ambitious standards and accomplishment

facets.label: Self-discipline
facets.focus: continuing effort despite boredom or distraction

facets.label: Deliberation
facets.focus: considering consequences before acting

pages.scenario: Before a software release, Priya tracks dependencies and confirms rollback ownership. When a low-risk wording change arrives, she approves it without rebuilding the entire plan. Her structure follows consequence rather than ritual; the useful observation is how she scales control to risk.
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: Structure can protect commitments and reduce avoidable errors, while spontaneity can preserve speed and responsiveness. Excessive control may consume time or resist updated priorities; too little tracking may shift hidden work onto others.
pages.combination_effects: Higher conscientiousness with higher neuroticism may produce careful preparation but also repeated checking under uncertainty. With lower neuroticism, the same planning tendency may feel steadier. Context and facet pattern remain necessary.
pages.action_experiment: Choose one recurring task and define a ‘minimum reliable system’ with one deadline, one owner, and one check. Compare it with your usual process for a week, noting errors prevented, time spent, and changes you accepted without re-planning.
pages.misconceptions: Conscientiousness is not honesty, intelligence, ambition, tidiness, or work value in every setting. A lower result does not prove laziness; overload, unclear ownership, health, or an unsuitable system can produce similar behavior.
pages.method_boundary: The broad domain-and-facet hierarchy is source-supported, but these behavioral prompts remain editorial hypotheses. A result cannot establish dependability for hiring, explain a missed deadline by itself, or guarantee that productivity advice will work.

visible_sources.limitation: Supports the broad structure, not individual work-performance judgments.
Supports a named hierarchical model, not equivalence across all facet taxonomies.

pages.title: 尽责性：计划、坚持与灵活调整之间的尺度
pages.summary: 从胜任、秩序、责任、成就追求、自律和审慎六个侧面观察执行倾向，同时检查结构带来的收益与成本。
pages.definition: 尽责性关注安排、履行承诺、追求目标、自我调节和行动前思考等倾向。它不是道德评分，也不能单凭一个结果判断谁更勤奋、更可靠，或某项任务是否值得坚持。

range.high: 较高结果可能表现为提前规划、持续跟进和认真对待承诺；当目标已经改变时，原有标准若不调整，也可能带来僵化与额外成本。
range.middle: 中间结果可能意味着按后果配置结构：高风险任务使用清单，容易撤回的小事保留弹性，而不是所有事情都用同一种流程。
range.low: 较低结果可能对应更即兴、反应更快或愿意保留选项；当协作需要长期追踪时，也可能更容易发生遗漏和交接不清。

facets.label: 胜任
facets.focus: 对实际能力与有效解决问题的感受

facets.label: 秩序
facets.focus: 对整理、系统和可预测摆放的偏好

facets.label: 责任
facets.focus: 对承诺、规则和义务的重视

facets.label: 成就追求
facets.focus: 为较高标准和成果投入努力

facets.label: 自律
facets.focus: 在无聊、疲倦或分心时继续推进既定任务

facets.label: 审慎
facets.focus: 行动前考虑后果、证据充分度与可逆性

pages.scenario: 备考小组里，陈默把十二周计划拆成每周目标；发现成员连续两周无法完成后，他删掉低价值环节，而不是要求大家补齐所有欠账。这里既有结构，也有重新排序。观察重点是他怎样根据反馈调整承诺，而不是只看表格做得多细。
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: 结构能够减少遗忘并保护多人协作，即兴能够提高应变速度。流程过重会挤占真正工作，追踪不足则可能把成本转移给同伴。合适的程度取决于风险、协作人数和是否容易撤回。
pages.combination_effects: 尽责性较高并伴随较高神经质时，准备可能更充分，也可能在不确定中反复确认；神经质较低时，相同的计划习惯可能显得更从容。仍需查看具体侧面与压力环境。
pages.action_experiment: 选一个每周重复任务，只保留截止时间、负责人和一次核对，形成“最低可靠系统”。连续一周记录它避免了什么错误、花了多少维护时间，以及你是否能在信息变化时及时调整。
pages.misconceptions: 尽责性不等于诚实、聪明、上进或整洁，也不能直接代表工作价值。看似拖延还可能来自负荷过高、目标含糊、健康状态或工具不合适，不能只用特质解释。
pages.method_boundary: 宽泛维度与层级描述有来源支持，具体行为解释仍是等待人工复审的假设。结果不能用于招聘可靠性判断，不能单独解释一次延期，也不保证某种效率方法有效。

visible_sources.limitation: 支持宽泛结构，不支持个体工作表现判断。

visible_sources.citation_label: Soto 与 John（2017）：BFI-2 层级模型
visible_sources.limitation: 支持已命名的层级模型，不证明所有侧面体系等价。

pages.title: Extraversion: social energy, participation, and stimulation
pages.summary: Examine how warmth, group seeking, assertiveness, pace, stimulation, and positive emotion may combine without equating quietness with shyness or leadership ability.
pages.definition: Extraversion describes tendencies in social engagement, energetic pace, assertive participation, stimulation seeking, and positive affect. It does not measure social skill, empathy, confidence in every setting, or whether someone prefers people to solitude at all times.

range.high: A higher result may fit frequent outward engagement, quicker entry into group interaction, or preference for active settings. It may also make quiet recovery or restrained turn-taking more deliberate.
range.middle: A middle result may fit alternating modes: active participation with familiar groups and quieter observation in new or demanding settings.
range.low: A lower result may fit selective social contact, lower stimulation needs, or preference for time to prepare. It can support concentrated work while making sustained high-intensity interaction tiring.

facets.label: Warmth
facets.focus: friendly approach and interpersonal closeness

facets.label: Gregariousness
facets.focus: preference for company and group presence

facets.label: Assertiveness
facets.focus: readiness to speak, direct, and influence

facets.label: Activity
facets.focus: pace, busyness, and energetic movement

facets.label: Excitement seeking
facets.focus: interest in intensity, novelty, and stimulation

facets.label: Positive emotions
facets.focus: frequency and expression of enthusiasm and joy

pages.scenario: In a planning workshop, Luis opens discussion quickly and draws quieter participants into the map. After two hours he asks for a written follow-up instead of another call. The pattern includes assertive participation and a limit on sustained stimulation; one lively meeting does not settle every facet.
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: Visible energy can accelerate connection and coordination, while lower stimulation needs can protect depth and listening. Frequent speaking can crowd out reflection; delayed participation can leave useful ideas unheard. Format and preparation can change the balance.
pages.combination_effects: Higher extraversion with higher agreeableness may appear as inclusive social energy; with lower agreeableness it may look more competitive or direct. The same overall score can therefore feel different to others.
pages.action_experiment: Across three interactions, choose a different participation move: speak early once, ask a question before offering a view once, and respond in writing once. Record energy, contribution quality, and who else gained space.
pages.misconceptions: Extraversion is not popularity, leadership, communication skill, courage, or happiness. Lower extraversion is not automatically shyness; anxiety, language, status, sensory load, and preference for preparation can produce similar visible behavior.
pages.method_boundary: The domain is a broad trait dimension with narrower facets in named models. These examples cannot diagnose social anxiety, determine team fit, or predict leadership performance; they remain draft prompts for voluntary reflection.

visible_sources.limitation: Supports the broad structure, not a judgment of social skill or leadership.
Supports one hierarchical operationalization, not universal facet equivalence.

pages.title: 外向性：社交投入、表达主动性与刺激需求
pages.summary: 从热情、合群、果断、活跃、寻求刺激和积极情绪六个侧面观察外向性，不把安静等同于胆怯或能力不足。
pages.definition: 外向性关注社交接近、活动节奏、主动表达、刺激需求和积极情绪等倾向。它不直接衡量社交技巧、同理心、领导能力，也不表示一个人在所有场合都同样健谈或喜欢独处。

range.high: 较高结果可能表现为更快加入互动、偏好活跃环境或愿意公开表达；在需要安静恢复和控制发言节奏时，可能要更主动地调节。
range.middle: 中间结果可能意味着根据熟悉程度和任务切换：在已有关系中积极，在陌生或高要求场景中先观察，再决定投入多少互动与刺激。
range.low: 较低结果可能对应更选择性地社交、较低刺激需求或需要准备时间；这有利于集中，也可能让连续高强度互动更疲惫。

facets.label: 热情
facets.focus: 友好接近和建立亲近感的方式

facets.label: 合群
facets.focus: 对陪伴、群体和共同活动的偏好

facets.label: 果断
facets.focus: 发言、引导和施加影响的主动程度

facets.label: 活跃
facets.focus: 生活节奏、忙碌程度和行动能量

facets.label: 寻求刺激
facets.focus: 对强度、新鲜与兴奋体验的兴趣

facets.label: 积极情绪
facets.focus: 热情、愉悦等情绪出现和表达的频率

pages.scenario: 远程项目第一次同步时，许安没有抢先发言，而是在聊天区整理大家的问题；进入熟悉的小组复盘后，她主动控场并推动决定。书面参与、关系熟悉度和角色授权共同影响表现，仅看第一次会议容易把准备偏好误写成稳定沉默。
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: 外显能量有助于快速连接，较低刺激需求有利于深入思考。持续主动可能压缩他人空间，等待太久也可能让关键意见缺席。改变会议形式、提前材料和书面渠道，往往能改变可见行为。
pages.combination_effects: 外向性较高且宜人性较高时，社交能量可能更包容；宜人性较低时，同样的主动表达可能更直接或竞争。组合只能提供观察方向，不能替代实际互动证据。
pages.action_experiment: 选择三次互动，分别尝试开场发言、先提问再表达、会后书面回应。记录精力消耗、贡献质量以及是否给别人留下空间，再比较哪种形式更适合不同任务。
pages.misconceptions: 外向性不是受欢迎程度、领导力、沟通能力、勇气或幸福感。较低外向性也不等于害羞；焦虑、语言、地位、感官负荷和准备偏好都可能形成相似表现。
pages.method_boundary: 外向性是宽泛维度，已命名模型可继续拆分侧面。这里的文字不能诊断社交焦虑、判断团队适配或预测领导表现，仅作为自愿复盘的待审阅草稿。

visible_sources.limitation: 支持宽泛结构，不支持社交技巧或领导力判断。

visible_sources.citation_label: Soto 与 John（2017）：BFI-2 层级模型
visible_sources.limitation: 支持一种层级操作化，不代表所有侧面体系通用。

pages.title: Agreeableness: cooperation, candor, and interpersonal boundaries
pages.summary: Consider trust, straightforwardness, altruism, compliance, modesty, and tender-mindedness without treating cooperation as virtue or disagreement as defect.
pages.definition: Agreeableness describes tendencies in trust, cooperation, concern for others, conflict response, and interpersonal presentation. It does not certify kindness, ethics, truthfulness, vulnerability to manipulation, or the quality of a particular relationship.

range.high: A higher result may fit quick cooperation, sympathetic attention, or preference for preserving relationships. It can make necessary disagreement or boundary-setting harder in some contexts.
range.middle: A middle result may fit conditional cooperation: supportive when interests align and more direct when stakes or evidence require challenge.
range.low: A lower result may fit skepticism, competitive debate, or willingness to confront disagreement. It can protect scrutiny while increasing friction if concern is not made visible.

facets.label: Trust
facets.focus: default expectations about others' intentions

facets.label: Straightforwardness
facets.focus: directness and reluctance to manipulate presentation

facets.label: Altruism
facets.focus: readiness to assist and invest in others' needs

facets.label: Compliance
facets.focus: response to conflict, pressure, and competing claims

facets.label: Modesty
facets.focus: how personal importance and achievement are presented

facets.label: Tender-mindedness
facets.focus: emotional concern for suffering and vulnerability

pages.scenario: During a retrospective, Naomi acknowledges a teammate's workload and still challenges a risky shortcut. She proposes a smaller test rather than avoiding the conflict or attacking the person. Cooperation and disagreement appear together; the pattern is about how concern and scrutiny are balanced.
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: Cooperation can preserve trust and reduce unnecessary conflict, while skepticism can expose weak assumptions. Over-accommodation may hide limits; relentless challenge may damage safety and information sharing. Effective behavior often separates respect for people from evaluation of proposals.
pages.combination_effects: Higher agreeableness with higher conscientiousness may support dependable helping but also overcommitment. With lower conscientiousness, warm intentions may not consistently become follow-through. Observed behavior matters more than a flattering label.
pages.action_experiment: In one low-stakes disagreement, write the shared goal, your non-negotiable boundary, and one question that could change your view. Afterward, note whether you protected both the relationship and the quality of the decision.
pages.misconceptions: Agreeableness is not kindness, honesty, empathy, passivity, or moral goodness. A lower result does not prove hostility, and a higher result does not prove safety or generosity. Power, culture, and current threat can alter visible conflict behavior.
pages.method_boundary: The domain is a broad descriptive tendency, not a relationship diagnosis or screening rule. These drafts cannot determine who is trustworthy, compatible, or ethical and should not be used for personnel decisions.

visible_sources.limitation: Supports the broad structure, not moral or relationship judgments.
Supports one hierarchical model, not universal facet equivalence or individual screening.

pages.title: 宜人性：合作、坦率与人际边界如何同时存在
pages.summary: 从信任、坦率、利他、顺从、谦逊和同情六个侧面观察合作倾向，不把配合等同于善良，也不把质疑写成缺陷。
pages.definition: 宜人性关注默认信任、合作、对他人的关切、冲突反应和自我呈现。它不能证明一个人善良、诚实或安全，也不能单凭分数判断某段关系的质量。

range.high: 较高结果可能表现为更快配合、更关注他人感受或愿意维护关系；在需要明确拒绝和提出异议时，也可能更费力。
range.middle: 中间结果可能意味着有条件地合作：共同目标清楚时支持，证据或边界受到挑战时更直接，并根据对方回应调整信任与投入。
range.low: 较低结果可能对应更怀疑、偏好竞争性讨论或愿意面对冲突；这有助于审查，也可能在关切未被表达时增加摩擦。

facets.label: 信任
facets.focus: 信息不足时对他人意图与可靠性的默认预期

facets.label: 坦率
facets.focus: 直接表达以及不操纵呈现的倾向

facets.label: 利他
facets.focus: 帮助他人并投入其需要的意愿

facets.label: 顺从
facets.focus: 面对冲突、压力和相互竞争诉求的反应

facets.label: 谦逊
facets.focus: 呈现个人重要性与成就的方式

facets.label: 同情
facets.focus: 对痛苦、脆弱和他人处境的情感关切

pages.scenario: 家庭商量假期时，赵青先确认老人行动不便的限制，也明确自己无法承担全部照护。他建议缩短行程并轮换任务。这里既有体谅，也有边界；如果只记录最后的妥协，就会漏掉她如何保护可持续合作。
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: 合作可以维护信任，怀疑可以暴露薄弱假设。过度迁就会隐藏负荷，持续对抗也会损害安全感和信息流动。有效做法常常是把对人的尊重与对方案的审查分开。
pages.combination_effects: 宜人性较高且尽责性较高时，帮助意愿可能更容易兑现，也可能导致过度承诺；尽责性较低时，温和态度未必稳定转化为行动。仍应回到实际履约证据。
pages.action_experiment: 选择一次低风险分歧，提前写出共同目标、不能退让的边界，以及一个可能改变你看法的问题。结束后复盘：你是否同时保护了关系和决策质量。
pages.misconceptions: 宜人性不等于善良、诚实、同理心、被动或道德水平。较低不证明敌意，较高也不证明安全可靠。权力、文化和当前威胁都会改变可见的冲突行为。
pages.method_boundary: 宜人性是宽泛描述，不是关系诊断或筛选规则。草稿不能判断谁可信、合适或有道德，也不得用于人员决策。

visible_sources.limitation: 支持宽泛结构，不支持道德或关系判断。

pages.title: Neuroticism: sensitivity to stress and negative emotion
pages.summary: Use anxiety, anger, depression, self-consciousness, impulsiveness, and vulnerability as observation prompts without turning a trait result into a mental-health diagnosis.
pages.definition: Neuroticism describes tendencies in sensitivity to threat, distress, frustration, self-conscious emotion, impulse under strain, and feeling overwhelmed. The term is a trait-domain label; it is not a diagnosis, symptom inventory, or measure of resilience in every circumstance.

range.high: A higher result may fit faster detection of possible problems, stronger negative emotion, or longer recovery after stress. Sensitivity can prompt preparation and can also amplify false alarms.
range.middle: A middle result may fit reactions that vary with stakes, uncertainty, sleep, support, and familiarity rather than staying consistently intense or muted.
range.low: A lower result may fit steadier affect or quicker recovery in many settings. It can support calm action while sometimes delaying recognition of subtle risk or others' distress.

facets.label: Anxiety
facets.focus: anticipation of threat, worry, and tension

facets.label: Anger
facets.focus: frustration, irritation, and hostile affect

facets.label: Depression
facets.focus: trait-language references to low mood and discouragement, not diagnosis

facets.label: Self-consciousness
facets.focus: sensitivity to scrutiny, embarrassment, and social evaluation

facets.label: Impulsiveness
facets.focus: difficulty resisting immediate urges under strain

facets.label: Vulnerability
facets.focus: feeling unable to cope when pressure accumulates

pages.scenario: An incident alert wakes Sam at night. He notices three possible failure paths, checks the one with the largest impact, and then hands off rather than monitoring every signal until morning. Sensitivity helped surface risk; a stopping rule prevented the alarm from consuming the whole night.
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: Threat sensitivity can catch weak signals and motivate preparation, while emotional steadiness can preserve judgment under pressure. Persistent alarm may exhaust attention; very low alarm may miss early warning. Support, sleep, and actual exposure change the pattern.
pages.combination_effects: Higher neuroticism with higher conscientiousness may produce detailed contingency planning or repetitive checking. With higher agreeableness, distress may be hidden to avoid burdening others. These combinations require observation, not assumption.
pages.action_experiment: When a low-stakes worry appears, write the feared outcome, current evidence, one reversible next step, and a stopping condition. Revisit after twenty minutes and record whether the action reduced uncertainty or merely repeated checking.
pages.misconceptions: Neuroticism is not a mental disorder, weakness, pessimism, lack of resilience, or proof that someone is unstable. A lower result is not immunity to distress. Acute stress, illness, trauma, unsafe conditions, and sleep loss require separate consideration.
pages.method_boundary: This public draft must never be used to diagnose, replace clinical assessment, or infer health status. Trait descriptions and facet labels are non-medical observation prompts; urgent or persistent distress belongs outside this content's decision boundary.

visible_sources.limitation: Supports the broad structure, not mental-health diagnosis or individual prognosis.
Supports one trait hierarchy; facet labels are not clinical symptom conclusions.

pages.title: 神经质：对压力与负面情绪的敏感倾向
pages.summary: 从焦虑、愤怒、抑郁、自我意识、冲动和脆弱六个侧面整理压力反应的观察，同时明确这些特质语言不是心理健康诊断。
pages.definition: 神经质描述对威胁、痛苦、挫折、被评价、压力下冲动和不堪重负的敏感倾向。这里的“神经质”是特质维度名称，不是疾病、症状清单，也不能概括一个人在所有处境中的韧性。

range.high: 较高结果可能表现为更快发现潜在问题、负面情绪更强或压力后恢复更慢；敏感能够促使准备，也可能增加误报。
range.middle: 中间结果可能意味着反应随风险、睡眠、支持和熟悉程度变化，而不是始终强烈或始终平静；需要用多个场景比较触发与恢复。
range.low: 较低结果可能对应许多场景下更平稳或恢复更快；这有利于压力中行动，也可能较晚注意到微弱风险或他人的不安。

facets.label: 焦虑
facets.focus: 对威胁的预期、担忧和紧张

facets.label: 愤怒
facets.focus: 遭遇阻碍时挫折、恼怒与敌意情绪的强度

facets.label: 抑郁
facets.focus: 特质语言中的低落和泄气，不是临床诊断

facets.label: 自我意识
facets.focus: 对审视、尴尬和社会评价的敏感

facets.label: 冲动
facets.focus: 压力下抵抗即时欲望的困难

facets.label: 脆弱
facets.focus: 压力持续累积时感到难以应对与恢复的程度

pages.scenario: 汇报前发现一处数字错误，唐薇立刻想到客户质疑、延期和返工三种后果。她先核对影响最大的口径，确认其余页面不受影响后停止搜索。敏感帮助她及时发现风险，预先设定的停止条件避免了整晚反复检查。
pages.strengths_tradeoffs: 威胁敏感能够捕捉弱信号并推动准备，情绪平稳有助于压力下保持判断。持续警报会耗尽注意力，警报过低也可能错过早期提醒。睡眠、支持和真实危险程度都会改变表现。
pages.combination_effects: 神经质较高且尽责性较高时，可能形成周密预案，也可能反复确认；宜人性较高时，可能为了不打扰他人而隐藏压力。这些都需要观察，不能从分数直接推出。
pages.action_experiment: 低风险担忧出现时，写下最怕的结果、已有证据、一个可逆步骤和停止条件。二十分钟后复盘：行动是否减少了不确定，还是只是重复检查。
pages.misconceptions: 神经质不是心理疾病、软弱、悲观、缺乏韧性或不稳定的证明；较低结果也不代表不会痛苦。急性压力、疾病、创伤、不安全环境和睡眠不足需要单独看待。
pages.method_boundary: 这份公开草稿不得用于诊断、替代临床评估或推断健康状态。特质与侧面名称只是非医疗观察提示；持续或紧急的痛苦不在本内容的决策边界内。

visible_sources.limitation: 支持宽泛结构，不支持心理健康诊断或个体预后。
